detail: director_gate.py fed dist/best_gate.json into the arch ship floor. That file is a running MAX over noisy n=40-48 gates (archaludon_meta_train.py 'if wr >= prev'), i.e. an upward-biased estimator. It reported arch 85.4 PASS while pooled meta said 76.66+-0.50 (arch, n=250) and 76.72+-0.37 (director independent, n=360) -> false PASS of ~8.7pp on the ONLY green floor. Also crustle_min used mean(min per cycle) = Jensen-biased LOW vs the correct min(mean_flg, mean_majkel); sim shows a Crustle sitting exactly on the 89.0 floor would pass only 2.67% of the time -> gate was unpassable by construction.
fix: arch ship authority = most-recent pooled 'meta' run from fleet/state/pooled_history.jsonl (n>=200, <=24h, fails closed if stale); best_gate.json demoted to display-only upper bound. crustle_min = min(mean_flg, mean_majkel), old value kept as crustle_mean_of_cycle_mins diagnostic.
